title: Inbox One
description: Composer anchored to the bottom edge of the agent window (sticky, full-width backdrop with a fade so rows scroll under it; same 800px column as the session composer so it doesn't jump when opening a session). Inbox moved to the top of the window, with the "Good evening" greeting at the very top, left-aligned to the inbox's edge. The docked composer is the Agents window's new-session composer; inline replies and open sessions use the session composer with that session's harness, model and permissions. Every picker opens its real options.
